questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the alternative which will improve the bracketed part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select "no improvement".**

The technical aspect of English that deals with ironies (has always intrigue) my inquisitive mind.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is-** ****'has always intrigued'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• Using **'has always intrigued'** in the place of **'has always intrigue'** to make the sentence correct.
 
• We know that the sentence is in the **present perfect** so that **3rd form** of the **main verb** will be followed after the **helping verb**. Replace **'intrigued' **instead of **'intrigue'**.
 
• **Structure of Presente Perfect:** Sub + has/have + V₃ + object
 
 
• ***Example:** He has gone to the market.*
 
 

**The correct sentence is-** *The technical aspect of English that deals with ironies **has always intrigued** my inquisitive mind.*

questions.question:

He said, “I am hungry.”

options.text: He said that he was hungry.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is-** 'He said that he was hungry.'**

__
 
• The reported verb is in the simple present tense (**I am)**. Thus, in the indirect speech, we will have **simple past tense**. I => **he**.
 
• Hence ***option 4*** is the most appropriate answer here.

**The correct Indirect specch is-** *He said that he was hungry.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

questions.question:
**A sentence has been given in Active/Passive Voice. Out of the four given alternatives, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Passive/Active Voice.**

The watch man opened the gate.

options.text: The gate opened the watch man.
The gate is being opened by the watchman.
The gate was opened by the watchman.
The gate is opened by the watchman.

questions.solution: The given sentence is in the past tense (**opened**). Thus, the passive voice will be of the form **was/were** + past participle of **open** = **opened** + by. Thus, Option 3) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the one which best expresses the meaning of the given word.**

Barbarous
questions.solution:
The correct answer is- **'Crude'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Barbarous'** is an **adjective **and it means **'extremely cruel or unpleasant, or failing to reach acceptable social standards'** so that the similar word of **'Barbarous'** is **'Crude'**. It is the most suitable option here. 

 
 
• ***Example:** His murder was an outrageous and** barbarous** act.*
 
• The word "crude" can have a few different meanings depending on the context. Here are two common definitions:
 
 
• 
 
***Crude ***(adjective): Rough or unrefined in nature, lacking sophistication or polish.

 ***Example***: The artist's early sketches were crude compared to her later masterpieces.

 
 
• 
 
***Crude ***(adjective): Vulgar or offensive in a way that is considered socially unacceptable.

 ***Example***: His crude jokes during the dinner party made everyone uncomfortable.

 
 
 
 
 

Hence ***option 3*** is the **most appropriate** answer here.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 *having or showing behavior that is respectful and considerate of other people.*
 
 

 **Civilized**
 *at an advanced stage of social and cultural development.*

questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option.**

Some girls are taking prior permission to (1)/ sport a loosely tied plait on the days (2)/ they had washed their hair. (3)/ No error (4)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is- **'error lies in the part-1'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence we are talking about the **two past** events so in this type of sentence the **first part **will come in a **simple past** and the **second part** will come in **past perfect**. The **second part **is already in the **past perfect** so here need to change the **first part** from the **present continuous** to **simple past.**

 
 
• ***Example:** Where you had gone when I called you?*
 
 

**The correct sentence is-** *Some girls **took** prior permission to sport a loosely tied plait on the days they had washed their hair. *
